question: What are the most influential papers on AlphaFold protein structure prediction? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The five most influential papers on AlphaFold protein structure prediction, ranked by citation count, are: (1) the landmark 2021 AlphaFold2 paper by Jumper et al. in Nature with ~36,810 citations; (2) the 2024 AlphaFold 3 paper extending predictions to biomolecular interactions with ~11,304 citations; (3) the 2020 precursor paper by Senior et al. using deep-learning potentials with ~2,877 citations; (4) the companion 2021 paper applying AlphaFold to the entire human proteome with ~2,672 citations; and (5) the ProteinMPNN paper on deep-learning-based protein sequence design with ~1,680 citations.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2","title":"Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold","citation_count":36810},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w","title":"Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3","citation_count":11304},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-019-1923-7","title":"Improved protein structure prediction using potentials from deep learning","citation_count":2877},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-021-03828-1","title":"Highly accurate protein structure prediction for the human proteome","citation_count":2672},{"doi":"10.1126/science.add2187","title":"Robust deep learning–based protein sequence design using ProteinMPNN","citation_count":1680}]}

parsed.answer: The five most influential papers on AlphaFold protein structure prediction, ranked by citation count, are: (1) the landmark 2021 AlphaFold2 paper by Jumper et al. in Nature with ~36,810 citations; (2) the 2024 AlphaFold 3 paper extending predictions to biomolecular interactions with ~11,304 citations; (3) the 2020 precursor paper by Senior et al. using deep-learning potentials with ~2,877 citations; (4) the companion 2021 paper applying AlphaFold to the entire human proteome with ~2,672 citations; and (5) the ProteinMPNN paper on deep-learning-based protein sequence design with ~1,680 citations.
